column1: # GeckoLib 4.0-4.4 (Minecraft 1.20.1) to GeckoLib 4.5+ (Minecraft 1.20.6 to 1.21.4) class moves.
# GeckoLib 4.5 folded its software.bernie.geckolib.core package into the main packages, so a mod
# built for 1.20.1 fails on a 1.21.1 host with NoClassDefFoundError:
# Derived from the core classes Fossils and Archeology 9.3.4.0 and the 4.8.4 to 5.5.2 table name,
# matched against geckolib-neoforge-1.21.1-4.9.3: a pair is taken when dropping "core/" lands on a
# 4.9.3 class or exactly one 4.9.3 class has that simple name. CoreGeoBone and CoreGeoModel were
# interfaces that 4.5 merged into the GeoBone and GeoModel classes.
